statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-47240 (GHSA-8p34-64r3-mwg8): before net-imap 0.5.15 and 0.6.4.1, the raw-data arguments of search, uid_search, sort, uid_sort, thread, uid_thread, fetch and uid_fetch can carry non-synchronizing literals without checking that the server supports them, and a server without that support may run the literal's contents as new pipelined commands (command injection); before 0.5.14 and 0.6.4 these arguments were not validated at all: https://github.com/ruby/net-imap/security/advisories/GHSA-8p34-64r3-mwg8. On the 0.5 release line it is fixed in net-imap 0.5.15, whose release notes name this advisory: https://github.com/ruby/net-imap/releases/tag/v0.5.15. In the DHI Alpine 3.23 repository, net-imap ships in the ruby3.4-net-imap package, which is built from the ruby-3.4 source with its own version number; ruby-3.4-full depends on it. We downloaded every published ruby3.4-net-imap package for Alpine 3.23 on x86_64 and aarch64, checked each against its repository index checksum, and compared its installed lib directory with the net-imap release from rubygems.org; each matches its release byte for byte: 0.5.8-r0 and 0.5.8-r1 install net-imap 0.5.8, 0.5.8-r2 installs net-imap 0.5.14, and 0.5.15-r2, 0.5.15-r3 and 0.5.15-r4 install net-imap 0.5.15. Each ruby-3.4 build is built together with the ruby3.4-net-imap package of the same package release (-rN): 3.4.8-r0 to 3.4.9-r1 with net-imap 0.5.8 (ruby3.4-net-imap 0.5.8-r0 and 0.5.8-r1); 3.4.9-r2, which upgrades the bundled net-imap to 0.5.14, with ruby3.4-net-imap 0.5.8-r2; and 3.4.10-r2 and every later build, whose Ruby releases bundle net-imap 0.5.15, with ruby3.4-net-imap 0.5.15-r2 to 0.5.15-r4 (0.5.15-r2 was published with ruby-3.4 3.4.10-r2). The published DHI Ruby 3.4.9 and 3.4.10 dev images for Alpine 3.23 install ruby-3.4 3.4.9-r2 with ruby3.4-net-imap 0.5.8-r2 (net-imap 0.5.14) and ruby-3.4 3.4.10-r3 with ruby3.4-net-imap 0.5.15-r3 (net-imap 0.5.15), on amd64 and arm64. The ruby-3.4-libs 3.4.9-r2 package also carries the net-imap 0.5.14 gem archive, identical to the rubygems.org file; ruby-3.4-libs 3.4.9-r1 carries none. So the first published ruby-3.4 build that ships the fix is 3.4.10-r2: the builds before it ship net-imap 0.5.8 or 0.5.14, and it and every later build ship net-imap 0.5.15.
